colorSpace: sRGB bytes converted from Three.js linear material.color after baked directional shading

shading.method: baked directional shading per world-space triangle normal, retaining source material RGB
shading.grain: deterministic integer hash, independent of geometry RNG
shading.roofNormalCorrection: upper roof shell winding oriented skyward; geometry unchanged
shading.occlusion: directional approximation, no ray-traced ambient occlusion

sampling.method: deterministic uniform triangle-surface sampling with per-layer minimum detail allocation

source.name: 澳門媽祖文化村天后宮

approximation: Proportions estimated from supplied aerial views; not surveyed dimensions.
Main arrangement, twin towers, open two-storey galleries and successive roof heights follow photographs.
Roof figures, stone carvings, inner rooms and inscription relief are simplified or inferred.
Source material palette is approximate; intended display is recolored particles.
